H5900.def: from «05892»; a citizen; Iru, an Israelite:--Iru.

H5904.def: from «05892» and «05175»; city of a serpent; Ir-Nachash, a place in Palestine:--Ir-nahash.

H5905.def: from «05892» and «08121»; city of the sun; Ir-Shemesh, a place in Palestine:--Ir-shemesh.

H5906.def: or mAsh {awsh}; from «05789»; the constellation of the Great Bear (perhaps from its migration through the heavens):-- Arcturus.

H5907.def: probably for «05909»; Akbor, the name of an Idumaean and of two Israelites:--Achbor.

H5908.et: probably from an unused root in the literal sense of entangling
H5908.def: probably from an unused root in the literal sense of entangling; a spider (as weaving a network):--spider.

H5909.et: probably from the same as (05908) in the secondary sense of attacking
H5909.def: probably from the same as «05908» in the secondary sense of attacking; a mouse (as nibbling):--mouse.

H5910.et: apparently from an unused root meaning to hem in
H5910.def: apparently from an unused root meaning to hem in; Akko (from its situation on a bay):--Accho.

H5911.def: from «05916»; troubled; Akor, the name of a place in Palestine:--Achor.

H5912.et: from an unused root meaning to trouble
H5912.def: from an unused root meaning to trouble; troublesome; Akan, an Israelite:--Achan. Compare «05917».

H5913.def: a primitive root; properly, to tie, specifically, with fetters; but used only as denominative from «05914»; to put on anklets:--make a tinkling ornament.

H5914.def: from «05913»; a fetter; hence, an anklet:--stocks, tinkling ornament.

H5915.def: feminine of «05914»; anklet; Aksah, an Israelitess:--Achsah.

H5916.def: a primitive root; properly, to roil water; figuratively, to disturb or affict:--trouble, stir.

H5917.def: from «05916»; troublesome; Akar, an Israelite:--Achar. Compare «05912».

H5919.et: probably from an unused root meaning to coil
H5919.def: probably from an unused root meaning to coil; an asp (from lurking coiled up):--adder.

H5920.def: from «05927»; properly, the top; specifically, the highest (i.e. God); also (adverb) aloft, to Jehovah:--above, high, most High.

H5921.et: properly, the same as (05920) used as a preposition (in the sing. or pl. often with prefix, or as conjunction with a particle following)
H5921.def: properly, the same as «05920» used as a preposition (in the singular or plural often with prefix, or as conjunction with a particle following); above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications (as follow):--above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, × as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, × both and, by (reason of), × had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-)on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, × with.

H5922.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05921»:--about, against, concerning, for, (there-)fore, from, in, × more, of, (there-, up-)on, (in-)to, + why with.

H5923.def: or mowl {ole}; from «05953»; a yoke (as imposed on the neck), literally or figuratively:--yoke.

H5925.def: feminine of «05923»; burden; Ulla, an Israelite:--Ulla.

H5926.et: from an unused root meaning to stutter
H5926.def: from an unused root meaning to stutter; stuttering:--stammerer.

H5927.def: a primitive root; to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative (as follow):--arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, + shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, × mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, + perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

H5929.def: from «05927»; a leaf (as coming up on a tree); collectively, foliage:--branch, leaf.

H5930.def: or mowlah {o-law'}; feminine active participle of «05927»; a step or (collectively, stairs, as ascending); usually a holocaust (as going up in smoke):--ascent, burnt offering (sacrifice), go up to. See also «05766».

H5931.def: (Aramaic) feminine from a root corresponding to «05927»; a pretext (as arising artificially):--occasion.

H5933.def: or Alyah {al-yaw'}; the same as «05932»; Alvah or Aljah, an Idumaean:--Aliah, Alvah.

H5934.et: pass part of (05956) in the denominative sense of (05958)
H5934.def: passive participle of «05956» in the denominative sense of «05958»; (only in plural as abstract) adolescence; figuratively, vigor:--youth.

H5935.def: or sAlyan {al-yawn'}; from «05927»; lofty; Alvan or Aljan, an Idumaean:--Alian, Alvan.

H5936.et: pass part of an unused root meaning to suck
H5936.def: feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to suck; the leech:--horse-leech.

H5937.def: a primitive root; to jump for joy, i.e. exult:--be joyful, rejoice, triumph.

H5939.et: from an unused root meaning to cover
H5939.def: feminine from an unused root meaning to cover; dusk:--dark, twilight.

H5941.def: from «05927»; lofty; Eli, an Israelite high-priest:--Eli.

H5944.def: feminine from «05927»; something lofty, i.e. a stair-way; also a second-story room (or even one on the roof); figuratively, the sky:--ascent, (upper) chamber, going up, loft, parlour.

H5945.def: from «05927»; an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (compar.); as title, the Supreme:--(Most, on) high(-er, -est), upper(-most).

H5948.et: from (05953) in the sense of completing
H5948.def: from «05953» in the sense of completing; probably a crucible (as working over the metal):--furnace.

H5949.et: from (05953) in the sense of effecting
H5949.def: or malilah {al-ee-law'}; from «05953» in the sense of effecting; an exploit (of God), or a performance (of man, often in a bad sense); by implication, an opportunity:--act(-ion), deed, doing, invention, occasion, work.

H5953.def: a primitive root; to effect thoroughly; specifically, to glean (also figuratively); by implication (in a bad sense) to overdo, i.e. maltreat, be saucy to, pain, impose (also literal):--abuse, affect, × child, defile, do, glean, mock, practise, thoroughly, work (wonderfully).

H5954.et: corresponding to (05953) (in the sense of thrusting oneself in), to enter
H5954.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05953» (in the sense of thrusting oneself in), to enter; causatively, to introduce:--bring in, come in, go in.

H5955.def: feminine active participle of «05953»; only in plural gleanings; by extens. gleaning-time:--(gleaning) (of the) grapes, grapegleanings.

H5956.def: a primitive root; to veil from sight, i.e. conceal (literally or figuratively):--X any ways, blind, dissembler, hide (self), secret (thing).

H5957.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05769»; remote time, i.e. the future or past indefinitely; often adverb, forever:--for ((n-))ever (lasting), old.

H5958.def: from «05956»; properly, something kept out of sight (compare «05959»), i.e. a lad:--young man, stripling.

H5959.def: feminine of «05958»; a lass (as veiled or private):--damsel, maid, virgin.

H5960.def: from «05956»; hidden; Almon, a place in Palestine See also «05963».

H5961.def: plural of «05959»; properly, girls, i.e. the soprano or female voice, perhaps falsetto:--Alamoth.

H5962.et: patrial from a name corresponding to (05867) contracted
H5962.def: (Aramaic) patrial from a name corresponding to 5867 contracted; an Elamite or inhabitant of Elam:--Elamite.

H5963.et: from the same as (05960) and the dual of (01690) [compare (01015)] with enclitic of direction
H5963.def: from the same as «05960» and the dual of «01690» (compare «01015») with enclitic of direction; Almon towards Diblathajim; Almon-Diblathajemah, a place in Moab: --Almon-dilathaim.

H5964.def: from «05956»; a covering; Alemeth, the name of a place in Palestine and of two Israelites:--Alameth, Alemeth.

H5965.def: a primitive root; to leap for joy, i.e. exult, wave joyously:--X peacock, rejoice, solace self.

H5966.def: a prim root; to sip up:--suck up.

H5968.def: a primitive root; to veil or cover; figuratively, to be languid:--faint, overlaid, wrap self.

H5970.def: a primitive root; to jump for joy, i.e. exult:--be joyful, rejoice, triumph.

H5971.def: from «06004»; a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock:--folk, men, nation, people.

H5973.def: from «06004»; adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English):--accompanying, against, and, as (X long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-)to, with(-al).

H5974.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05973»:--by, from, like, to(-ward), with.

H5975.def: a primitive root; to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive):--abide (behind), appoint, arise, cease, confirm, continue, dwell, be employed, endure, establish, leave, make, ordain, be (over), place, (be) present (self), raise up, remain, repair, + serve, set (forth, over, -tle, up), (make to, make to be at a, with-)stand (by, fast, firm, still, up), (be at a) stay (up), tarry.

H5976.def: for «04571»; to shake:--be at a stand.

H5977.def: from «05975»; a spot (as being fixed):--place, (+ where) stood, upright.

H5978.def: prol. for «05973»; along with:--against, by, from, + me, + mine, of, + that I take, unto, upon, with(-in.)

H5980.def: from «06004»; conjunction, i.e. society; mostly adverb or preposition (with prepositional prefix), near, beside, along with:--(over) against, at, beside, hard by, in points.

H5981.def: the same as «05980»; association; Ummah, a place in Palestine:--Ummah.

H5982.def: or ammud {am-mood'}; from «05975»; a column (as standing); also a stand, i.e. platform:--X apiece, pillar.

H5983.def: from «05971»; tribal, i.e. inbred; Ammon, a son of Lot; also his posterity and their country:--Ammon, Ammonites.

H5984.def: patronymically from «05983»; an Ammonite or (the adjective) Ammonitish:--Ammonite(-s).

H5986.def: from «06006»; burdensome; Amos, an Israelite prophet:--Amos.

H5988.def: from «05971» and «0410»; people of God; Ammiel, the name of three or four Israelites:--Ammiel.

H5989.def: from «05971» and «01935»; people of splendor; Ammihud, the name of three Israelites:--Ammihud.

H5990.def: from «05971» and «02064»; people of endowment; Ammizabad, an Israelite:--Ammizabad.

H5991.def: from «05971» and «02353»; people of nobility; Ammichur, a Syrian prince:--Ammihud (from the margin).

H5992.def: from «05971» and «05068»; people of liberality; Amminadab, the name of four Israelites:--Amminadab.

H5993.def: from «05971» and «05081»; my people (is) liberal; Ammi-Nadib, probably an Israelite:--Amminadib.

H5994.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06012»; profound, i.e. unsearchable, deep.

H5995.def: from «06014»; a bunch of grain:--handful, sheaf.

H5996.def: from «05971» and «07706»; people of (the) Almighty; Ammishaddai, an Israelite:--Ammishaddai.

H5997.et: from a primitive root meaning to associate
H5997.def: from a primitive root meaning to associate; companionship; hence (concretely) a comrade or kindred man:--another, fellow, neighbour.

H5998.def: a primitive root; to toil, i.e. work severely and with irksomeness:--(take) labour (in).

H5999.def: from «05998»; toil, i.e. wearing effort; hence, worry, wheth. of body or mind:--grievance(-vousness), iniquity, labour, mischief, miserable(-sery), pain(-ful), perverseness, sorrow, toil, travail, trouble, wearisome, wickedness.
